Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Can Lorenzo Detuono pay 5 blood to take control of the minion he was
facing in combat if ...

1/ the minion was a vampire, and he/she was burned during combat (with
Disarm / Decapitate, for example) ?

2/ the minion was an ally (imbued or not) that was burned during
combat ?

3/ the minion was an Illusions of the Kindred that was burned during
combat...
a/ and Detuono is acting ?
b/ and Detuono is reacting ?

4/ the minion was an Illusions of the Kindred that was sent to torpor
during combat...
a/ and Detuono is acting ?
b/ and Detuono is reacting ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
floppyzedolfin wrote:
> Can Lorenzo Detuono pay 5 blood to take control of the minion he was
> facing in combat if ...
>
> 1/ the minion was a vampire, and he/she was burned during combat (with
> Disarm / Decapitate, for example) ?

Yes. Card text.

> 2/ the minion was an ally (imbued or not) that was burned during
> combat ?

Yes. Card text.

> 3/ the minion was an Illusions of the Kindred that was burned during
> combat...
> a/ and Detuono is acting ?
> b/ and Detuono is reacting ?

Yes. And then the Illusion is removed from the game, by card text.

> 4/ the minion was an Illusions of the Kindred that was sent to torpor
> during combat...
> a/ and Detuono is acting ?
> b/ and Detuono is reacting ?

Yes. And then the Illusion is removed from the game, by card text.
